mixed_origin_policy: 06a controls are market test rows; 06b controls are synthetic only. Real 06b rows are showcase-only. Never pool these cohorts for accuracy or confidence intervals.

default.assumptions: Fresh successful run, no retries/resumes: two global 20-chart repeatability gates plus 40 calls per job. Planning throughput 0.6–1.8 GPU seconds per single-image call with concurrency1, batch1, eager/cacheless execution without batch invariance; add 5–15 startup minutes. Historical Exp03 request median 594.704ms is context, not measured throughput for these larger charts. Serial parity, hardware and caching can move runtime outside this range. No timing measured for corrected06 serial configuration.

resume: Completed jobs make no new inference calls. Partial jobs rerun their40-call repeatability gate; retries add requests. Global gates run at each GPU session.
